content: Following separation agreements, the court implemented division of two homes, assigning one to each party with a €100,000 equalization to Partner 1. The interpretive problem was how prior arrangements and improvements affect the equalization. Framed under residual community and equitable division, the court credited prior sums and property already obtained, and acknowledged improvements by the assignee. Principles: equalization measures the difference between half the value and benefits already received; agreed allocations at separation can inform, but do not bind, the division; costs compensated. 1.
